answer.book: A volume of several works: Johann Heinrich Alsted's Latin supplement to Panstratia Catholica tome IV on spiritual manducation, transubstantiation and the Mass (14 chapters), followed by his Tractatus de Ecclesia in five books, an appended lecture by Prideaux and a Turretin disputation, framed by a preface, an overview and three indexes.
